note: Both sets extract the key engineering data (Design Point values, curve trends in Regions 2 and 3) with similar accuracy. However, Set A contains significantly more duplicate claims (e.g., Blade Pitch 0° stated three times, TSR 20 at 3 m/s stated twice, Design Point CP twice). Set B is slightly more concise, though it still has some duplicates (Gen Torque, Design Point CP). Set B also provides slightly better condition descriptions for some claims (e.g., specifying Region 2 for Power Coefficient). Both sets share the inconsistency of providing two different values for Rotor Thrust at 10 m/s.
remarks: Both sets struggle with consistent entity binding (sometimes '15-MW rotor', sometimes the property name). Both sets invent/contradict on Rotor Thrust at 10 m/s (listing both a grid-line value and a peak value for the same condition). Set A's higher volume of claims is due to redundancy rather than additional information.
